description: This file defines an interface for a grain in Orleans, a virtual actor framework. The interface includes a method for getting a counter associated with a stream namespace.

classes.name: IFilteredImplicitSubscriptionGrain
classes.description: A grain interface extending Orleans' IGrainWithGuidKey, representing grains that support implicit subscription filtering.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a counter value associated with the specified stream namespace.
